notes: Summary: large bank-aligned research org. Strong preference for dedicated capacity + key management integration (HSM/KMS). Primary workload is production-grade research portal: embeddings index ~350M vectors expected in production (current POC 35M). Reranking applied on top of vector recall to improve precision for compliance-sensitive answers. Latency targets: p99 reranked response <200ms (aiming for <150ms for interactive analyst queries). Cost sensitivity: wants clear cost-per-query at 1k QPS sustained and during end-of-day batch reranks. Data residency is a hard requirement (US-only), plus audit logs retained 7 years for compliance team. Current POC notes: "embedding quality is good with open-encoder-384", but they see regressed throughput with default batching; SE recommended continuous batching + KV cache and model quantization for Dedicated tier. They asked: "Can we guarantee no outbound model telemetry?" Legal wants KMS/HSM addendum and proof of no plaintext keys in Redwood control plane.
requirements_summary: Workload: RAG/search with embeddings + reranking; indexing scale target 300M-400M vectors; expected peak QPS 800-1,200; tail latency target p99 <200ms; strict US data residency; KMS + HSM for key custody; prefer dedicated GPU pools with SLA-backed latency; rolling canary + fallback to smaller cheaper model during heavy load.
technical_notes: POC ingest: 35M docs -> 120M vectors after chunking. Vector dimension 768. Client requests support for sharded ANN index (HNSW/IVF) and server-side reranker (cross-encoder) co-located on same dedicated nodes to avoid network hop. Suggested config: 4x A10G-equivalent nodes (staging) for 1M vectors each; scale plan to 40 nodes for 400M. SE recommended throughput testing at 1k simulated analysts (concurrency ~450). Observability ask: token-level cost breakdown per route + per-model breakdown. Also want automatic fallback policy to smaller quantized model in case Dedicated capacity saturated.
procurement_notes: Procurement prefers annual reserved commit. Finance asking for line-item TCO: reserved capacity cost, storage for vectors, KMS HSM add-on, support 24x7. They requested cost per 1k queries and cost for end-of-day bulk reranking run (5M queries/minute window). AE provided initial pricing scenarios in /drive/pricing/cedarcrest_dedicated_scenario_v2.pdf. Next legal: KMS addendum + DPA in review.
